policy: Fail closed on geographic compatibility. Official is provenance, not a quality score. Preserve conflicting estimates and source vintages.

maddison2001.author: Angus Maddison
maddison2001.title: The World Economy: A Millennial Perspective
maddison2001.rights: Selected factual estimates and bibliographic metadata only; book not bundled.
maddison2001.limitations: Historical reconstruction, sometimes based on proxies and assumptions. Not an official census. Later revisions may differ.

bg2012.author: Stephen Broadberry and Bishnupriya Gupta
bg2012.title: India and the Great Divergence: An Anglo-Indian Comparison of GDP per Capita, 1600–1871
bg2012.edition: Working paper, 25 June 2012; not the revised 2015 three-author article
bg2012.rights: Selected factual estimates; no book or article text bundled.
bg2012.limitations: Working-paper vintage retained. National reconstruction and wage proxies have different spatial support; neither is automatically a British Raj aggregate.

japan2026.author: Stephen Broadberry, Kyoji Fukao and Tokihiko Settsu
japan2026.title: How did Japan catch-up with the West? Some implications of recent revisions to Japan’s historical growth record
japan2026.edition: Asia-Pacific Economic History Review 66(1), 3–32; first online 12 October 2025
japan2026.rights: Selected factual values; linked open-access article.
japan2026.limitations: Table 1 reproduces two reconstructions sharing underlying evidence. They are alternatives, not independent observations to average.

uk1901.author: Census Office, England and Wales
uk1901.title: Census of England and Wales 1901, General Report: The United Kingdom
uk1901.edition: General Report, section XIV; digitized by A Vision of Britain
uk1901.limitations: Published census enumeration; not a mid-year national-accounts population. Not an imperial total.

uk1911.author: Census Office, England and Wales
uk1911.title: Census of England and Wales 1911, General Report with Appendices
uk1911.limitations: Census-date totals, not annual averages. Exact dates for each component are retained only when verified.

sa1913.author: J. Scott Keltie (editor)
sa1913.title: The Statesman’s Year-Book 1913
sa1913.rights: Public-domain historical book; factual values only.
sa1913.limitations: Digitized transcription is marked not proofread. Total and province values corroborated against US Census comparative table; colonial enumeration may undercount.

saCheck.author: US Bureau of the Census
saCheck.title: The Blind in the United States, 1910
saCheck.edition: Comparative international population table, Union of South Africa rows
saCheck.limitations: Secondary publication of South African census totals; not a second independent census.

nz1896.author: E. J. von Dadelszen, Registrar-General
nz1896.title: Report on the Results of a Census of the Colony of New Zealand taken for the night of 12 April 1896
nz1896.edition: Report, Part I chapter 1; Part VI chapter 43; Part VIII chapter 46
nz1896.rights: Historical census factual values; original publication linked.
nz1896.limitations: Māori census was separate (February). Education and employment tables exclude Māori; education summary additionally excludes Chinese and includes children.

brazil1872.limitations: Census reference date 1 August 1872. Enumeration coverage is not a claim that all Indigenous peoples were counted; precise reconciliation to Cliopatria is pending.

india1901.title: Intercensal Growth of Population: reproduced earlier census reports
india1901.limitations: British India including Burma and princely states; earlier enumerations omitted territories. Boundary concordance and census exclusions still require review.
